prompts.prompt: Edit the provided sprite atlas into a NEW training body animation atlas, preserving its flat illustrated Flash-era cartoon style, bold clean black ink outlines and compact chibi proportions. Absolutely NO HEADS, NO FACES, NO HAIR, NO HELMETS: each body ends in a small flat-topped peach neck stub for attaching the game's existing personalized head. Blue jersey with white piping, white trousers, black shoes, peach arms and neck, identical character identity and scale throughout. Truly transparent background, no backdrop, no shadows, no text, no labels, no lines, no grid marks, no watermark. Exact rectangular grid FOUR COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 24 separate sprites total, portrait canvas. Every row is one exercise, columns are its four sequential animation key poses: starting position, half movement, full movement, half return. Generous transparent padding in each of the 24 equal cells, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Keep each body's center of mass centered in its cell and use the same anatomical scale throughout. Exercise equipment when required must be complete and stay inside its cell. Neck must remain easy to identify with a flat peach top. Upper arms should not occlude the neck. STRETCHING atlas. Six rows from top to bottom: 1) standing TRUNK TWIST, hands at waist, hips planted, torso twists left then right; 2) standing KNEE HUG, hands pull one bent knee toward chest, foot lowers; 3) seated LEG STRETCH, one leg extended forward on floor and torso leans forward; 4) KNEE BEND, two-leg squat shallow to deep and return; 5) SIDE LUNGE, wide planted stance and bend to one side, return; 6) WALKING LUNGE, forward split stance bending front knee down then rising. Front/three-quarter view, never turn fully away. Four visibly distinct coherent poses per row, knees and hands anatomically clear. No bats, baseballs or gloves.
